sources.title: Baxter Research Robot SDK
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Yaskawa Motoman 工業手臂平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付串聯彈簧圖與兩點辨識表。；教學物件允許 0.7 N，原柔順配置通過、較硬方案失敗；不得由此推論人體接觸安全。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a series-spring diagram and two-point identification table.; With a teaching object limit of 0.7 N, the original compliance configuration passes and the stiffer design fails; this says nothing about human-contact safety.
related.difference: 區分平均扭矩、RMS 扭矩與峰值扭矩。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish mean, RMS and peak torque.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 串聯剛度 1/k=1/k1+1/k2；相同接觸力在兩個元件上產生位移。；教學 k1=200 N/m、k2=600 N/m，總壓縮 x=0.004 m。；k=150 N/m；F=150×0.004=0.60 N。
電流近似與扭矩成比例時，發熱近似隨 τ²；τrms=sqrt(Στ²t/Σt)。；教學扭矩 2 N·m 持續 1 s、4 N·m 持續 0.5 s、1 N·m 持續 2 s。；τrms=sqrt((4+8+2)/3.5)=2.0 N·m。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Series stiffness satisfies 1/k=1/k1+1/k2; the same contact force deflects both elements.; Teaching k1=200 N/m, k2=600 N/m and total compression x=0.004 m.; k=150 N/m; F=150×0.004=0.60 N.

When current is proportional to torque, heating scales approximately with τ²; τrms=sqrt(Στ²t/Σt).; Teaching segments: 2 N·m for 1 s, 4 N·m for 0.5 s and 1 N·m for 2 s.; τrms=sqrt((4+8+2)/3.5)=2.0 N·m.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NASA Robonaut 太空機器人
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付串聯彈簧圖與兩點辨識表。；教學物件允許 0.7 N，原柔順配置通過、較硬方案失敗；不得由此推論人體接觸安全。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a series-spring diagram and two-point identification table.; With a teaching object limit of 0.7 N, the original compliance configuration passes and the stiffer design fails; this says nothing about human-contact safety.
related.difference: 由指尖接觸力推算手指關節力矩，辨識接觸點偏移的影響。
related.differenceEn: Compute finger-joint moment from fingertip force and inspect contact-point sensitivity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 串聯剛度 1/k=1/k1+1/k2；相同接觸力在兩個元件上產生位移。；教學 k1=200 N/m、k2=600 N/m，總壓縮 x=0.004 m。；k=150 N/m；F=150×0.004=0.60 N。
平面關節力矩 τ=Fr，力相同而力臂增加仍會提高關節需求。；教學接觸力 F=5 N，垂直力臂 r=0.020 m，假設靜態。；τ=5×0.020=0.100 N·m。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Series stiffness satisfies 1/k=1/k1+1/k2; the same contact force deflects both elements.; Teaching k1=200 N/m, k2=600 N/m and total compression x=0.004 m.; k=150 N/m; F=150×0.004=0.60 N.
Planar joint moment is τ=Fr; a larger lever raises demand even at unchanged force.; Teaching contact force F=5 N and perpendicular lever r=0.020 m under static conditions.; τ=5×0.020=0.100 N·m.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
